subject: how to get the credibility interval for function of several parameters ?

messages.author: 70841ac97b5c8e1b
messages.subject: how to get the credibility interval for function of several parameters ?
parts:
I am fitting a state-space model using INLA, and it works very well. The detail of my model is 

the  hidden states  beta0t , and beta1t are AR(1) processes;  X is a covariate, beta0 and beta1 are "fixed" parameters ;

My goal is to obtain the mean, and the 95% credibility interval (band) for Pt= exp( eta_t) /( 1+exp(eta_t) ),

where eta_t = beta0 + beta0t +(beta1+beta1t)*X.    t=1,...,T

Using INLA, we can obtain the posterior densities for all betas. 

Is there any command to get the posterior densities (or 95% credibility interval)  of Pt (t=1,...,T)?   like inla.tmarginal?

If not, one way I can think of is to use delta method and assume all the posterior densities of betas are normal. Is this the right direction? 


Thanks in advance.


Best,

Ximing

I guess by eta_t you mean the linear predictor, if not, you can compute
its posterior marginals using linear combinations; see

http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-I-have-some-linear-combinations-of-the-nodes-in-the-latent-field-that-I-want-to-compute-the-posterior-marginal-of-is-that-possible-


We guess that you have a logit link function, so your p_t are the fitted
values; see

http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-How-can-I-do-predictions-using-INLA-

and the option control.compute=list(link=1) ## in the simplest case

otherwise, you can use inla.tmarginal to transform the marginals of
eta_t.
